text:
Alex P: Quick sync — preparing the webinar landing + benchmark narrative. Need final keyword map, schema, internal links, and a redirect plan for old assets. Who can own redirects + inbound UTM routing?
Mira G: I can own keyword map + schema, will update the doc by EOD. putting primary/secondary kws and meta desc variants in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example (draft).
Sam T: I’ll take redirects & routing. Plan is to map old blog URLs to the new landing slugs. Question: prefer full 301s or keep client-side JS redirects for some legacy pages?
Elaine R: 301s for SEO where possible. Also add canonical tags on webinar page and the long-form benchmark post to avoid duplication. :thumbsup:
seo-bot: Reminder: after changes run the Structured Data Testing tool and the schema validator: https://validator.schema.org
Alex P: Mira — for the Q&A section do FAQ schema + Event schema, or just FAQ? We have slides + live event fields.
Mira G: Add both: FAQ for the on-page Q&A and Event (onlineEvent) for the webinar metadata. I'll paste the JSON-LD in the head. TODO: hero H1 with primary kw, alt titles for AB test.
Sam T: Draft nginx rule I’ll stage:```rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /webinar/$1 permanent;``` planning to preserve UTMs by appending `?utm_source=webinar` if not present. Thoughts?
Elaine R: For internal linking: run a site-wide anchor sweep to add contextual links from product and docs -> webinar + benchmark. I’ll coordinate with Content Ops to avoid link bloat.
Alex P: Tracking/CRM: inbound form should populate hidden fields: source=webinar-2026, keyword_bucket, and original_url. Also route leads by region to the right owner in HubSpot. @Mira can you add hidden fields?
Mira G: Yep — adding hidden fields and wiring GA4 events. Also uploading two meta description variants for AB: (A) benefit-first, (B) numbers-first.
Sam T: I’ll push 301s to staging tonight, plan prod deploy tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need staging thumbs from @Elaine and @Alex.
Elaine R: Will review staging at 10:00 PT and check internal links + canonical headers.
Alex P: Can we also run a short pre-launch crawl to find orphaned pages and duplicate titles? Seo-bot can we kick that after staging QA?
seo-bot: Scheduled: sitemap ping + crawl after staging approval. Will output orphan list to the shared sheet.
Alex P: Quick checklist for TOMORROW (owner): 1) Redirects staged (Sam) 2) Schema + meta (Mira) 3) Internal link list (Elaine) 4) Tracking + forms (Mira) 5) Final QA + sitemap ping (Sam). Confirm?
Sam T: Confirmed — will update the redirect spreadsheet with exact 301 mappings.
Mira G: Confirmed — will add JSON-LD snippets and AB meta copies.
Elaine R: Confirmed — will deliver internal link list and do staging review.
Alex P: Thanks team — once staging is green, we’ll schedule the push and the webinar promo email. :rocket:
